content.short: CUDIS makes an AI smart ring for sleep and recovery tracking, tied to a longevity rewards protocol.
content.description: CUDIS makes an AI-powered smart ring that tracks sleep, heart-rate variability and recovery without a subscription, paired with a longevity protocol that rewards healthy habits on-chain. It runs a CUDIS Ring mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory. Linking a physical wearable to on-chain rewards is one of the clearer consumer uses of crypto incentives.
content.meta: CUDIS makes an AI smart ring for sleep and recovery tracking with on-chain rewards, and a World App mini app.
